page.layout: Running head at top, centred. Below it one full-width paragraph of Latin prose. Then two parallel columns: left, Rhaetic (Romansh) text with a heading; right, Italian text with a heading. Each column is numbered articles. No margin notes. Printed page number 128 at head right.

main_text.p: è régione, ad manifestius utriusq; discrimen declarandum:
main_text.head: Rhætice.
main_text.p: 1. Eug crai in Dei; pap tuottas chiauffas puffaunt, creader a-aig tfchel e de la terra
2. Et in Christam feis fulett naad Filgnoafs fegner:
3. Chi ais cuntzep ped da lg Spiert fa-ingk, nafchúd da Maria la vearna.
4. Ghi haa indúrad fuot Pontzio Pilato, mifsftin la crufah, moart, o fapulyd, yd givo ad iffiern.
6. In lg tearz dy ais rastiftad fu da ls moarts.
7. Yd ftin in ls tfchels izèza da la dretta da Deis bap, tuottas chiauffas puffaunt.
main_text.head: Italicè.
main_text.p: 1. Io credo in Dio padre Onnipotente, creator del cielo & de la terra.
2. Et in Gjesu Christo fuo figliuolo unigenito, noftro Signore.
3. Il qual fu concepiuto di Spirito santo, nacque di Maria vergine.
4. Patì sotto Pontio Pilato: fu crocifisso, morto e sepolto: discese a gl'inferi.
5. Risuscitò il terzo giorno da morte.
6. E salito in cielo: siede a la destra di Dio, padre onnipotente.

page.notes: Left column numbering as printed: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 7. The Italian has 1 to 7, so the Rhaetic "5" is probably misprinted as "6" and the second "7" is likely a misprint. Printed as seen. Rhaetic words are uncertain throughout: the Romansh spelling is hard to read and "tfchel", "chiauffas", "puffaunt" and "fegner" may be inexact. Some line-end words were joined without a visible hyphen. Italian item 7 is cut off at the bottom of the page; only "Di la verra a giù" is legible. Printed "Pon-tio" and "fa-to" hyphens at line ends have been joined.
